modules: 事件同步协议与游标
第二台设备通过认证连接拉取事件流，使用单调 cursor、增量范围和 resume token；断线后从最后确认位置继续。客户端确认已应用的事件，服务端保留必要窗口并检测游标丢失，重建时使用快照加增量而不是跳过事件。
设备身份与只读投影
每台设备有独立身份和短期会话，只读副本从事件构建任务、产物和设备状态，不直接复制主库。投影记录来源事件版本，发现未知事件或 schema 不兼容时进入需要升级状态，不把不完整副本显示成最新。
冲突、重放与敏感范围过滤
同一实体出现冲突时保留双方版本、事件来源和解决规则，按类型定义以主设备或明确用户选择为准。同步过滤凭据、敏感记忆、原始附件和大字段；重放事件不能再次触发外部副作用，过滤规则变化要使旧 cursor 失效并重建。
设备状态与离线验证
设备页显示在线、最后同步、执行位置、同步延迟和本地副本版本。离线设备不阻塞主设备的新任务，重新上线后补齐事件；验收要证明设备切换不丢任务、投影可重建、旧 cursor 不重复、敏感数据不被无条件复制。
Event sync protocol and cursors

A second device connects with authentication and pulls the event stream using a monotonic cursor, incremental range, and resume token; reconnect continues from the last acknowledged position. Clients acknowledge applied events, the server retains a bounded window and detects cursor loss, and rebuild uses snapshot plus increments rather than skipping events.
Device identity and read-only projection

Each device has its own identity and short session. A read-only replica builds tasks, artifacts, and device state from events instead of copying the primary database. Projection records the source event version; unknown events or incompatible schemas enter Needs upgrade instead of showing an incomplete replica as current.
Conflicts, replay, and sensitive-scope filtering

On entity conflict, retain both versions, event sources, and resolution rule; by type, prefer the primary device or an explicit user choice. Sync filters credentials, sensitive memory, raw attachments, and large fields. Replay cannot repeat external effects, and filter changes invalidate old cursors and force rebuild.
Device state and offline verification

The device page shows online state, last sync, execution location, sync delay, and local replica version. An offline device does not block new primary-device tasks, and catches up on reconnect. Acceptance proves task continuity, rebuildable projections, no duplicate old cursors, and no unconditional sensitive-data copy.
能力目录与任务匹配
每台设备声明执行器、应用、文件范围、网络条件和资源能力；任务声明最低能力、目标设备和数据位置。路由先做硬约束过滤，再比较在线、负载和成本；无设备满足时显示缺失能力，不把任务发送到能力不足的设备。
路由、lease 与单写者
任务分配生成有期限的 DeviceLease 和 fencing token，所有写操作携带 token；旧 lease 或较小 token 的写入被拒绝。主设备保留控制面权威，执行设备只处理被授权任务；租约过期可安全回收，但不能造成双写或重复外部动作。
离线队列与执行权交接
离线时任务进入可解释的排队状态，保留目标、预算和截止时间；设备恢复后按顺序领取。执行权交接先冻结旧设备、确认 lease 失效、再分配新设备；未完成的外部动作先对账，不因迁移重复发送或覆盖。
故障注入与回执一致性
注入设备掉线、时钟漂移、lease 过期、旧 token 写入、双设备竞争和部分成功。每个外部动作仍要求 Receipt 与对账；验收证明多设备不重复执行、离线恢复有明确状态、设备切换可继续、旧 lease 不会形成双写。
Capability catalog and task matching

Each device declares executors, applications, file scope, network conditions, and resources; tasks declare minimum capability, target device, and data location. Routing filters hard constraints first, then compares online state, load, and cost. If no device qualifies, show the missing capability instead of sending to an incapable device.
Routing, lease, and single writer

Assignment creates a time-bounded DeviceLease and fencing token; every write carries the token, and writes from stale leases or smaller tokens are rejected. The primary device retains control-plane authority while execution devices handle only delegated tasks. Expired leases are reclaimable without dual writes or duplicate external effects.
Offline queue and execution handoff

Offline tasks enter an explainable queued state preserving target, budget, and deadline, then claim in order on reconnect. Handoff freezes the old device, confirms lease invalidation, then assigns a new device. Reconcile unfinished external actions first; migration never resends or overwrites blindly.
Fault injection and receipt consistency

Inject device loss, clock drift, lease expiry, stale-token writes, dual-device contention, and partial success. Every external action still requires Receipt and reconciliation. Acceptance proves no duplicate execution, explicit offline recovery, continuable handoff, and no dual write from a stale lease.
远程撤销与会话失效
用户可从任一已授权设备撤销丢失设备，服务端立即吊销会话、密钥和待执行分配，并通知相关设备停止同步。撤销记录包含原因、时间、影响任务和审计 ID；正在执行的任务转为需要人工处理，不能因设备离线而延迟失效。
密钥轮换与安全重配对
新设备配对生成新密钥，旧密钥在确认迁移后失效；历史事件用保留的公钥或签名链继续验证。重新配对需要主设备确认和短期码，不能仅凭旧设备令牌恢复；轮换失败保留旧路径但明确风险，不允许降级到无加密。
加密传输、推送与设备凭据
控制面、同步和设备 RPC 使用 TLS 与端到端签名，推送中继只处理密文和最小路由元数据。设备凭据存放在系统安全存储，短期有效，不能进入日志、任务上下文或备份明文；日志和诊断导出默认脱敏。
审计、异常告警与丢失演练
记录配对、登录、审批、同步、撤销、密钥轮换和异常访问，提供用户可读的设备审计。演练设备丢失、撤销未完成、旧设备重新上线、恶意重放和紧急 kill switch；确认旧设备无法审批、接管或读取新事件。
Remote revocation and session invalidation

From any authorized device, revoke a lost device; the server immediately invalidates sessions, keys, and pending assignments and tells related devices to stop sync. The record includes reason, time, affected tasks, and audit ID. Running tasks enter Needs attention and cannot wait for the lost device to come online.
Key rotation and secure re-pairing

A new device pairing creates new keys, and old keys expire after migration confirmation. Preserve public keys or a signature chain to verify history. Re-pairing requires primary-device confirmation and a short code, not an old device token. Failed rotation may retain the old path only with explicit risk; never downgrade to plaintext.
Encrypted transport, push, and device credentials

Control plane, sync, and device RPC use TLS and end-to-end signatures; the push relay handles only ciphertext and minimal routing metadata. Device credentials live in system secure storage, are short-lived, and never enter logs, task context, or plaintext backups. Logs and diagnostics are redacted by default.
Audit, anomaly alerts, and loss drills

Audit pairing, login, approval, sync, revocation, key rotation, and abnormal access in user-readable form. Rehearse device loss, incomplete revocation, an old device returning, malicious replay, and emergency kill switch; confirm the old device cannot approve, take over, or read new events.
加密备份与完整恢复
备份包含事件范围、产物根、记忆引用、技能版本、配置和校验清单，使用独立密钥加密。恢复先验证版本、校验和与密钥，再在隔离目录重放事件；只有事件、产物、记忆和技能验证全部通过后才切换为可用实例。
迁移清单与版本锁定
每次升级生成 MigrationPlan，列出源版本、目标版本、schema 变更、执行器版本、不可逆步骤、备份引用和回滚路径。升级前检查磁盘、权限、队列和兼容性；执行器版本锁定，避免恢复后静默使用不同行为。
升级、回滚与迁移验证
升级按步骤执行并记录 checkpoint，失败时自动进入维护模式并恢复备份。回滚只恢复已知可用版本，保留失败证据；迁移后核对事件连续性、产物哈希、记忆来源、技能签名和凭据引用，任何一项不一致都阻断启动。
空库演练与用户健康检查
从空数据库完成安装、创建任务、备份、删除数据、恢复、升级和回滚，确认不依赖手工改库。健康页显示版本、最后备份、迁移状态、已知限制和下一步；验收要求历史事件、记忆、技能和凭据引用在迁移后保持一致。
Encrypted backup and complete restore

A backup contains event range, artifact roots, memory references, skill versions, configuration, and a checksum manifest, encrypted with a separate key. Restore validates version, checksum, and key, then replays events in an isolated directory. Switch to the restored instance only after events, artifacts, memory, and skills verify.
Migration manifest and version pinning

Every upgrade produces a MigrationPlan listing source and target versions, schema changes, executor versions, irreversible steps, backup reference, and rollback path. Preflight checks disk, authority, queue, and compatibility. Pin executor versions so restore never silently changes behavior.
Upgrade, rollback, and migration verification

Upgrade step by step with checkpoints; failure enters maintenance mode and restores the backup. Rollback returns to a known-good version while preserving failure evidence. After migration, verify event continuity, artifact hashes, memory provenance, skill signatures, and credential references; any mismatch blocks startup.
Empty-database drills and user health checks

From an empty database, complete install, task creation, backup, deletion, restore, upgrade, and rollback without manual database edits. The health page shows version, last backup, migration state, known limits, and next action. Acceptance requires events, memory, skills, and credential references to remain consistent after migration.
资源调度、配额与公平性
为每个任务和设备设置并发、CPU、内存、磁盘、Token 和外部调用配额，按优先级与等待时间调度。单个任务不能饿死其他任务，资源耗尽时排队或安全降级，并告诉用户是哪类资源不足。
watchdog、自动恢复与磁盘管理
监控心跳、卡死任务、事件循环、磁盘水位和日志大小；异常时先停止新任务、保存状态，再按策略重试或转人工。日志轮转、旧产物清理和备份保留都有上限；自动恢复不能绕过审批或重复副作用。
长期指标、维护模式与诊断导出
记录运行时长、队列深度、失败率、恢复次数、备份状态、资源趋势和未处理告警。维护模式暂停新任务但保留查看、审批和取消；诊断导出包含版本、健康快照和脱敏日志，不泄露凭据或敏感记忆。
压力测试、降级与远程 Sandbox 判断
做长时间运行、资源耗尽、内存泄漏、状态漂移和磁盘满测试，确认安全降级且任务不丢失。评估远程 Sandbox 是否真的降低风险；默认不引入新安全边界，若引入必须重新做权限、数据位置和撤销审计。
Resource scheduling, quotas, and fairness

Set concurrency, CPU, memory, disk, Token, and external-call quotas per task and device, scheduling by priority and wait time. One task cannot starve others. Exhaustion queues or degrades safely and tells the user which resource is insufficient.
Watchdog, automatic recovery, and disk management

Monitor heartbeats, stuck tasks, the event loop, disk watermarks, and log size. On anomaly, stop new tasks, preserve state, then retry or hand over by policy. Log rotation, old-artifact cleanup, and backup retention are bounded. Automatic recovery never bypasses approval or repeats effects.
Long-term metrics, maintenance mode, and diagnostics export

Track uptime, queue depth, failure rate, recovery count, backup state, resource trend, and unresolved alerts. Maintenance mode pauses new tasks while preserving view, approval, and cancellation. Diagnostics export includes version, health snapshot, and redacted logs, never credentials or sensitive memory.
Stress tests, degradation, and remote-Sandbox decision

Run soak, resource exhaustion, memory leak, state drift, and full-disk tests, confirming safe degradation without task loss. Evaluate whether a remote Sandbox truly reduces risk; by default introduce no new boundary. If added, redo authority, data-location, and revocation audits.
Stage 0–6 出口审计
建立逐条证据矩阵，把每个阶段出口映射到可复查的任务、测试、日志、报告和线上页面。缺少证据就是未完成，不能用“后续会补”豁免；对每个缺口记录负责人、影响和是否阻断发布。
八类任务覆盖与人工边界
审计研究、文档、代码、邮件、日历、网页、数据和桌面八类任务，标出可完成、可依赖、仅建议、必须转人工的范围。每类至少有一个真实任务、失败样本和恢复路径，不用演示任务替代真实使用证据。
安全红队、故障与迁移演练
执行越权、注入、秘密泄露、重复副作用、设备丢失、断电、升级失败和恢复失败演练，记录发现、修复和残余风险。完成隐私说明、安装器、升级路径、支持文档和已知限制，确保用户能从空环境安装并恢复。
最终评测、v1.0 发布与维护
发布成功率、人工分钟、Token、成本、失败类型、恢复率和用户信任报告，逐条满足 25.15 的“100% 定义”。确认没有严重未解决的安全或恢复问题后发布 v1.0，并进入维护、任务族扩展和长期反馈，而不是继续补基础产品。
Stage 0–6 exit audit

Build an evidence matrix mapping every stage exit to reviewable tasks, tests, logs, reports, and live pages. Missing evidence means incomplete; later-work promises are no exception. Each gap records owner, impact, and release-blocking status.
Eight-family coverage and human boundary

Audit research, documents, code, email, calendar, web, data, and desktop tasks, marking Completable, Reliable, Suggest-only, and Human-required scopes. Each family needs at least one real task, failure sample, and recovery path; demo tasks never replace real-use evidence.
Security red team, fault, and migration drills

Exercise privilege escalation, injection, secret leakage, duplicate effects, device loss, power loss, failed upgrade, and failed restore, recording findings, fixes, and residual risk. Complete privacy guidance, installer, upgrade path, support docs, and known limits so a user can install and restore from an empty environment.
Final evaluation, v1.0 release, and maintenance

Publish success, manual minutes, Token, cost, failure classes, recovery rate, and trust evidence meeting every condition in the 100% definition. Release v1.0 only with no severe unresolved security or recovery issue, then move into maintenance, task-family expansion, and long-term feedback rather than finishing the foundation.
